It is the responsibility of callers to\n  acquire `dbMu` before issuing queries and to use `sq` for any string values.\n- `initDB` creates the schema with `IF NOT EXISTS` and writes schema version `1`.\n- `POST /v1/storage/reset` drops and recreates all tables for test isolation.\n\n### Routing\n\n- Routes are registered with the standard library `http.ServeMux` pattern syntax\n  introduced in recent Go versions (e.g., `GET /health`,\n  `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance`).\n- `r.PathValue(\"id\")` extracts path parameters.\n- The server always listens on `127.0.0.1` and uses `net.JoinHostPort` to\n  handle the `PORT` env var safely.\n\n### JSON responses\n\n- `writeJSON` sets `Content-Type: application/json` and encodes the body.\n- `writeError` is the single helper used for all error envelopes and produces\n  `{\"error\": \"...\"}`. Choose the file that matches the domain (or create a new file in `package main`).\n2. Add the request/response structs with explicit `json` tags; keep the field\n   names and tags stable because the test suite depends on them.\n3.
